page0.text:
I'll go help Sakura out.
She's making breakfast for four people, so it'll take longer. I also want to ask her about last night.
It seems like Saber went with my story, but it's entirely possible they didn't get along and I want to make sure everything's all right.

page1.text:
"Good morning, Senpai. I've already started preparing breakfast."
"Ah, morning, Sakura. Let me help you with that."
I put on an apron and make my way into the kitchen.

page2.text: "Oh, then please do the grilling. Hmm, I just cooked the rice, so I'll make the miso soup and the side dish."

page3.text:
As always, Sakura is quick and efficient.
She doesn't seem to be putting on a front, so it doesn't look like yesterday is particularly bothering her, but...

page4.text:
"Sakura. Um, about yesterday..."
"Yes? What do you mean, Senpai?"

page5.text: "Well, yesterday, the three of you had to share a room, right? You seemed to be worried about having Saber stay, so I was wondering how it went."

page6.text: "I don't know what you mean when you say it like that. Please just ask me clearly what it is you want to know or I can't answer."

page7.text:
"Uh... S-so, it'd be nice if you all got along..."
"Oh. Would it make you happy if Saber and I got along?"

page8.text:
"...Well, it would help me out. I decided on Saber's stay without your permission, right? It'd be reasonable for you to resent her at the very least for that.
But, if you can overlook that and be nice to Saber, um..."
"Then I'd make you happy?"

page9.text:
"..."
It's embarrassing to say it out loud, so I just nod.

page10.text:
...Yeah.
I'd be thankful if she overlooked this and got along with Saber.
Since Sakura's like family, I don't want her upset over something that I did without her input.

page11.text:
"Then, to answer your question...
By midnight last night we managed to work it out.
I still find her a bit hard to deal with, but I think we can get along. She is difficult to understand, but she does have a cute side, I suppose."

page12.text:
Sakura's smile is genuine and heartfelt.
That makes me really happy.
It truly does, but...

page13.text:
"Cute... You mean, Saber!?"
"That is how I see it. Ms. Fujimura already treats her like she's known her for ages and Saber seems to have taken to it easily enough.
We were actually sharing a room to keep an eye on her, but starting tonight we are going to room together because we want to."

page14.text:
"..."
T-that is an unexpected turn of events.
But Saber's cute side, huh... She certainly is rather beautiful, but "cute" doesn't seem quite right...
